title: Rat Master Longsword
description: Turns the Amarite Longsword into a RAT's Mischief styled longsword!
body:
A simple lil' pack that turns Amarite Longswords into a Rat Master Longsword. I got the idea from `temperyeet` in the Rattiest Gang discord, and it seemed like a cool idea!

I took a lot of inspiration from @Azverial, and used the colors from the Clothed Ingot from RAT's Mischief as reference for these!
